name: Linking Books
location: Hidden or found through mechanisms on Myst Island and in the library.
acquisition_hint: Books are not ordinary reading material; they can transport the player to Ages.
uses: Travel to self-contained Ages such as Selenitic, Stoneship, Mechanical, and Channelwood.

name: Red and Blue Pages
location: Found across Ages and returned to the corresponding trap books.
acquisition_hint: Each Age contains pages tied to the red or blue prison books.
uses: Restores clearer communication with Sirrus or Achenar.

name: Atrus Page
location: Hidden on Myst Island as part of the final decision path.
acquisition_hint: The green book is important, but acting on it too early can lead to a bad outcome.
uses: Allows Atrus to complete the Myst book in the good ending route.
